notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
- Sometimes, after finding a watch, the screen didn't go back to previous screen. Now it goes back with no problems. 
- Sometimes clicking on coffee makes game crash. Now it doesn't. 
Updates:
- Added one more track of background music
- One of the scenes was changed in a more logical way.
- Scene's "Skip" button got bigger.
